changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led Security Crew handoff from authorized finding validation to reviewed change, deployment and independent retest.

title: Finding to Verified Remediation
description: Connect an authorized, validated security finding to owned remediation and independent retest of the affected deployed asset.
setup_prompt: Use Finding to Verified Remediation as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Security Crews, written scope and allowed methods, finding and asset records, severity policy, issue and source records, change approval, deployment, retest source, and closure authority. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, an exact finding handoff, explicit validator steps, and one manual case. Show the plan before Builder applies it. Selection does not scan, create a ticket, merge, deploy, retest, close a finding, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Written target and environment scope, allowed methods and evidence handling
Authorized finding ID, source, affected asset and exact build
Severity, remediation, risk acceptance and closure rules
Security, change, release, retest and closure owners
Issue, source, CI, deployment and retest records or exports
Manual-only or reviewed authenticated finding event

focus_areas: Whether applicable findings have owned decisions and authorized scope
